custom_tools.answer: User-configured MCP servers supply custom tools to threads and subagents over Streamable HTTP or STDIO.

persistent_requirements.answer: A user can request a repository spec before implementation and save approved checklists or reference files in Drive across threads. This is a file workflow, not a separate specification entity.

human_edits.answer: People can edit Drive files in the browser; this can include manually saved specifications.

agent_edits.answer: Agents can update or remove saved Drive files on request and automatically save changes as work completes.

revisions.answer: Drive history names the threads that saved versions and restores an older version as a new one; history lasts 24 hours.

approvals.answer: The documented spec-first prompt asks the agent to stop for changes or a go-ahead. This is instruction-based approval, not an enforced specification gate.

later_retrieval.answer: Files saved in a Drive scope are available to subsequent threads in that scope.

caches.answer: Project snapshots cache the post-setup filesystem, including installed dependencies. A restored checkout runs refresh only when its HEAD changes.

duplicate_installs.answer: A snapshot restore skips clone and initialize; missing or failed snapshots fall back to full setup. This reduces repeated setup but does not prove all installs are deduplicated.

cancellation.answer: Stop run cancels the timers and background commands the thread is waiting on; its subagents keep running.

host_awareness.answer: Docs explicitly warn that side chats on the same machine compete for heavy-command resources; adaptive host scheduling is not established.

provisioning.answer: Email invitations add members; admins can permit verified email-domain joining. SCIM provisioning was not established.

network.answer: The optional Tailscale integration limits private-service reachability through the user tailnet ACLs. General internet egress approval was not established.

lifetime.answer: Per-machine Tailscale auth keys expire after five minutes and are not saved in snapshots. This is not a general tool-approval lifetime.

tunnels.answer: Optional Tailscale gives enabled cloud projects private network access without public exposure. It is not a user-facing remote-client tunnel.

tests.answer: Named test commands such as pnpm test run on demand by a person or agent. They do not run automatically.

lint.answer: A named pnpm lint command can be configured and run on demand. No automatic lint gate was established.

types.answer: The command system explicitly includes typecheck actions, run on demand rather than automatically.
